notes.title: Summer 2025 Update
notes.content:
Mega Summer 2025 update!
 
Perform tricks and watch your crowd go wild!
 
Play with your preferred language! The game is now localised to 8 languages!
English, Spanish, German, French, Portuguese, Italian, Finnish, Swedish
 
New Locations:
- Bounce across forest rivers and watchtowers!
- Smash the bell in the castle ruins!
 
Plus:
- Bug fixes & SDK upgrades

notes.title: Post-launch Hotfix #1
notes.content:
This patch fixes some bugs in the launch version:
[list]
[*] Fix headwear of female flipper
[*] Fix a couple audio issues
[*] Fix a rare bug with specific spin & trick combination
[/list]

notes.title: Flip Master Early Access is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
We're happy to announce today release of Flip Master early access version on Steam! Buy the game now (with 40% launch discount), and enjoy:
[list]
[*] Tons of cool locations and special trampolines!
[*] Countless skills, flips tricks to unlock!
[*] Mad minigames!
[*] Crazy Power-ups!
[*] Various amazing characters with customizable clothing!
[/list]
The game is available for Windows and Apple Silicon, includes full support for PlayStation & Xbox game controllers - and runs great on Steam Deck!

We have worked hard to make Flip Master the most dynamic and entertaining trampoline experience on Steam. But we believe there's always room for improvement based on user feedback. As part of the Early Access program, we value your insights, suggestions, and feedback to help us make the game even better on Steam. We will be actively improving the Steam version during the early access.

You can share your suggestions, feedback and ideas in our Suggestions and ideas sub-forum in the community pages at https://steamcommunity.com/app/2793770/discussions/1/


Check out the early access Steam launch trailer below:

[previewyoutube=HKgQSVEqDGU;full][/previewyoutube]

See you soon on the trampoline! 
The Flip Master Development Team
